from solution import find_char


def test_issue_example():
    """Find all three, four, five characters long words as in example."""
    result = find_char('For the four consumer complaints contact manager AKR reddy')
    expected = ['For', 'the', 'four', 'AKR', 'reddy']  # len('For')=3 keep, len('the')=3 keep, len('four')=4 keep, len('consumer')=8 drop, len('complaints')=10 drop, len('contact')=7 drop, len('manager')=7 drop, len('AKR')=3 keep, len('reddy')=5 keep
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_three_char_word():
    """Find all three characters long words."""
    result = find_char('cat')
    expected = ['cat']  # len('cat')=3 keep
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_four_char_word():
    """Find all four characters long words."""
    result = find_char('dogs')
    expected = ['dogs']  # len('dogs')=4 keep
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_five_char_word():
    """Find all five characters long words."""
    result = find_char('hello')
    expected = ['hello']  # len('hello')=5 keep
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_two_char_excluded():
    """Only three, four, five characters long words are found so two is excluded."""
    result = find_char('ab cat')
    expected = ['cat']  # len('ab')=2 drop (3-1), len('cat')=3 keep
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_six_char_excluded():
    """Only three, four, five characters long words are found so six is excluded."""
    result = find_char('planet dogs')
    expected = ['dogs']  # len('planet')=6 drop (5+1), len('dogs')=4 keep
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_long_word_no_substring():
    """Long words are not split into three to five character substrings."""
    result = find_char('consumer')
    expected = []  # len('consumer')=8 drop, no 3-5 substring allowed
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_empty_string():
    """Find words in the given string handles empty input."""
    result = find_char('')
    expected = []  # len('')=0 drop, no 3-5 long word present
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_mixed_one_to_six_lengths():
    """Find all three, four, five characters long words among mixed lengths."""
    result = find_char('a an the four hello planet')
    expected = ['the', 'four', 'hello']  # len('a')=1 drop, len('an')=2 drop, len('the')=3 keep, len('four')=4 keep, len('hello')=5 keep, len('planet')=6 drop
    assert result == expected


def test_contract_returns_list():
    """Example shows find_char returns a list."""
    result = find_char('cat dogs')  # len('cat')=3 keep, len('dogs')=4 keep so list expected
    assert isinstance(result, list)


def test_contract_preserves_order():
    """Words are found in left-to-right order as in example."""
    result = find_char('hello cat dogs')
    expected = ['hello', 'cat', 'dogs']  # len('hello')=5 keep first, len('cat')=3 keep second, len('dogs')=4 keep third
    assert result == expected
